rationale: Phase B3c (portfolio_positioning fleet buildout): the directory publish leg goes kind-aware. Five defects on the live rows, all verified 2026-08-15: (1) the trigger's find-sites query gated opt-in on content_features.model_directory ONLY, so a site opted into any other kind could never be found, and a site opted into model_directory alone would receive every kind the publisher hard-coded; (2) the deployed-component predicate named only the model-directory components; (3) the has-claims gate was EXISTS over directory_claims with no kind at all - any kind's claims unblocked every kind; (4) ORDER BY s.domain LIMIT 5 - deterministic alphabetical starvation, site #6 never publishes, silently, forever; (5) the publisher chain hard-coded model->company->protocol, so the three Phase B finance kinds (profiles in the binary since v1.0.1301) were structurally unpublishable. The fix is config-only (no roll): the trigger returns one row per DUE (site, kind) - opt-in, deployed component, and publishable claims all checked PER KIND, mirroring QueryDirectoryEntries' definition of publishable (active entities, is_current+found claims) - and fans out its existing proven spawn+call loop once per pair; the publisher becomes ONE render->commit pair parameterised by input_data.kind. The 2026-07-26 silent-model-default trap is closed UPSTREAM of the action: kind joins the publisher's input_contract.required and call_agent's ValidateInputContract fails a call missing it (loud, not model). The `kind!` strict marker was considered and rejected: the running binary v1.0.1302 was built before RFC_029's strict-marker commit (1806371ef, 2026-08-15 14:07Z) - config must not outrun the binary. A publisher-internal loop over kinds was considered and rejected on mechanism: loop iterations suffix output fields (_N) and coordinator prefixConfigStepReferences rewrites only a dataRefKeys whitelist that does NOT include git_commit's files_field, so a render->commit pair inside a loop reads a field that no longer exists. Fan-out at the trigger keeps every cross-step reference linear. 427's council-reviewed posture carries over: no error_step on the commit step; isolation now comes from the per-pair fan-out plus the trigger loop's continue_on_error. ORDER BY random() under LIMIT 12 replaces the deterministic starvation: every due pair gets positive probability each cycle; true staleness-ordering needs a publish stamp the schema does not have - recorded as a residual, not smuggled in. Applied 2026-08-15 18:10Z after snapshot_agent backups of both rows; first kind-aware run force-triggered and verified at the artefact (per-kind entity counts differ; finance kinds correctly produce zero rows - no opted-in site yet). Submitted FORCE=1 per the 411 precedent: a DB config migration under docs/ that defines a production workflow running unattended on a schedule.

plan.summary: Migration 429 (applied + verified live 2026-08-15): the directory publish leg goes kind-aware. The trigger's find-sites query returns one row per due (site, kind) across all six register kinds with per-kind opt-in, per-kind deployed-component and per-kind publishable-claims predicates (replacing three kind-blind ones), ORDER BY random() LIMIT 12 replaces the deterministically-starving ORDER BY domain LIMIT 5, and the publisher becomes one render->commit pair parameterised by input_data.kind with kind REQUIRED by its input contract so a kind-less call fails loudly instead of silently publishing the model register (the 2026-07-26 defect class). Seed synced to live in the same task. First kind-aware run verified at the artefact: 3 pairs, per-kind entity counts 44/40/8 (differ, as they must), per-kind files and commit messages, served JSON fresh at each run's completion second, finance kinds correctly self-gated to zero rows.
plan.risks: (1) VALUES-mapping lockstep: the kind->spec_key->components mapping in the trigger's SQL must track Go's directoryPublishProfiles - a kind added in Go without a row here silently never publishes. Registered in DIR-001 and being added to LANDMINES with the footprint; the alternative (deriving the mapping at run time) needs a Go-side query action change, i.e. a roll, and B3c is deliberately config-only. (2) ORDER BY random() gives probabilistic fairness under a binding LIMIT, not staleness ordering - true due-ordering needs a per-(site,kind) publish stamp the schema does not have. Residual recorded; at today's fleet (3 due pairs) the LIMIT does not bind at all. (3) An old-config trigger run in flight at apply time would call the new publisher without kind; contract validation fails that call loudly and the next cycle self-heals. Checked before applying: zero in-flight orchestrations for both types. (4) rerender_queued=0 on all three kinds - identical pre- and post-429 (the 17:33Z pre-429 run also returned 0/0/0), so observed-unchanged rather than introduced; noted to the owning model_directory_pipeline lane rather than chased from B3c.

edits.rationale: The migration: snapshot-first (two-arg snapshot_agent for BOTH rows), dual-active + idempotency + drift-anchor guards pinned to the exact post-411/427 shape, both UPDATEs in ONE transaction (no cycle can see a kind-aware trigger with a kind-blind publisher), DO/RAISE verify throughout using IS DISTINCT FROM (a missing jsonb path yields NULL and plain <> can never fire), and EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN ' || query so a JSON-mangled SQL string aborts the COMMIT instead of failing at the first live run.
edits.sketch:
UPDATE agent_definitions SET default_config = jsonb_set(default_config, '{workflow}', $json${
  "start_step": "render_directory_json",
  "steps": {
    "render_directory_json": {"action": "render_directory", "config": {"site_id": "input_data.site_id", "kind": "input_data.kind"}, ...},
    "commit_directory": {"action": "git_commit", "config": {"files_field": "directory_render_result.files", "domain_field": "directory_render_result.domain", "commit_message_field": "input_data.commit_message", "commit_message": "Update directory data: {{.domain}}"}, ...no error_step (427)...},
    "complete": {...}}}$json$::jsonb),
  input_contract = '{"required": ["site_id", "domain", "kind"]}'::jsonb
WHERE type = 'model-directory-publisher' AND is_active AND COALESCE(is_snapshot,false)=false AND deleted_at IS NULL;

-- trigger: one row per DUE (site, kind); VALUES mapping in lockstep with Go's directoryPublishProfiles
"query": "SELECT site_id, domain, kind, commit_message FROM (SELECT DISTINCT s.id::text AS site_id, s.domain, m.kind, m.commit_message FROM (VALUES ('model','model_directory','model-directory','model-directory-listing','Update model directory'), ('company','adoption_tracker',...), ('protocol','protocol_tracker',...), ('mortgage-lender','mortgage_lender_directory',...), ('savings-provider','savings_provider_directory',...), ('health-insurer','health_insurer_directory',...)) AS m(kind, spec_key, snippet_component, listing_component, commit_message) CROSS JOIN sites s JOIN site_specs ss ON ss.site_id = s.id AND ss.aspect = 'classification' AND ss.is_current = true WHERE (ss.data->'content_features'->m.spec_key->>'recommended')::boolean = true AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pages p JOIN page_components pc ON pc.page_id = p.id JOIN content_components cc ON cc.id = pc.component_id WHERE p.site_id = s.id AND p.build_status = 'deployed' AND cc.function IN (m.snippet_component, m.listing_component)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM directory_claims dc JOIN directory_entities de ON de.id = dc.entity_id WHERE de.kind = m.kind AND de.status = 'active' AND dc.is_current AND dc.status = 'found')) due ORDER BY random() LIMIT 12"
-- loop: max_iterations 12; input_mapping gains "kind": "current_site.kind", "commit_message": "current_site.commit_message"
